description: Read app reviews two ways: pass app_id for live store reviews of ANY app — App Store or Google Play — (no tracking needed, storefront selectable), or omit it to read the workspace's tracked apps with sentiment, topics and improvement areas attached. Live Google Play rows carry no title (Play reviews have none). Cost: 1 credit per row returned (an empty page costs 1).

app_id.description: Any app to read reviews for, whether or not the workspace tracks it. Accepts 'apple:284882215', 'google:com.duolingo', a bare Apple track id, an Android package name, or a store URL. Reviews come straight from the store and carry no sentiment/topic enrichment; Google Play rows have no title.
app_id.title: App Id

country.description: Two-letter storefront code the reviews are read from, e.g. 'US', 'DE' (default 'US'). Only applies when 'app_id' is used. For Google Play this also picks the review language of that storefront.
country.title: Country

limit.description: How many reviews to return, 1-100. If omitted: 20 for assistant sign-in connections, 50 with an API key. Each returned review costs 1 credit, so ask for the page size you need.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: How many reviews to skip before returning results. Live store reads ('app_id' set) reach the 200 newest reviews per app and storefront, so page until 'has_more' is false rather than to a fixed depth; workspace reads page the full stored history.
offset.title: Offset

store.description: Filter to reviews from one store: 'apple' or 'google'.
store.title: Store

store_id.description: Filter to one app by its store-native id, e.g. '284882215' or 'com.spotify.music'.
store_id.title: Store Id

topic.description: Filter by an extracted topic label, e.g. 'pricing', 'onboarding', 'bugs'.
topic.title: Topic

tracked_app_id.description: UUID of one tracked app in the caller's workspace. Omit to read reviews across all tracked apps.
tracked_app_id.title: Tracked App Id

name: get_app_reviews
title: Get app reviews
